ask: Where should the export be built, and where should admins start it?
problem: Organizations fear being locked in. Admins can download progress sheets today, but they cannot take out the recordings, the details about them, and the full history together.
found: The server has a job runner with lots of memory and a bucket holding every recording. The web server has little memory and short time limits. Reports and the admin area already exist.
changed: Nothing yet, only this question. After your answer, admins will get an Export all data button. It gives one zip. The zip holds audio folders, a recording list, progress sheets and the full history.
why: The zip may be very large. It needs a place with plenty of memory and no short time limit. A stored file lets the admin close the page and come back.
touches: Options A and B keep a zip in storage for a while. They also note who asked. Option C does neither. No option adds new kinds of events.

options.label: Server job, button on the Organization screen
options.result: The admin starts the export where they manage people and roles. A job builds the zip, progress shows there, and a download link appears when it is ready.

options.label: Server job, button in the Reports section
options.result: Same engine, but the button sits beside the progress downloads admins already use.

options.label: Build inside the web server and stream it
options.result: No stored file and no link. The zip downloads as it is built. Large organizations may time out or run out of memory.
